qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 5dd9a78 and serialized fix rechecks of the revised tree ea3a478, committed signed as 4d7eed0, found the original scoped-coverage and comprehensibility defects resolved; consistency and quiz safety were clean from the start, and correctness was clean apart from the source-preservation item. 結果 restores EN's ケッカ reading note and translates the example as «Проверив, мы выяснили причину»; 節約 gives 手間（てま）を省く and gains a conservative 貯金 guard; 組合 gives **組合の会員**（くみあいのかいいん）; 籠 says «Птица вышла из клетки» as EN "came out"; and 経由 explains 途中 as «в пути или в процессе дела». Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes, including the staged-tree recheck while commit signing was unavailable, are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 33 EN exclusions across 18 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 24 direct, one-sided exclusions on 18 new cards: 結論–判断; 今に–もうすぐ/いずれ; いずれ–どの/どっち; 結局–末; 経由–通過; 営業–売る; 態度–行儀; 位置–所/場; 立場–見解; 位–くらい; 級–水準; 納得–承知; 精々–以下; 範囲–額; 節約–省く/貯金; 節–曲/点/特徴; 答案–答; 筆–手. One was added after review: 節約–貯金, a conservative guard because «экономия» and «сбережения» are close in Russian. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 16 relative links across the 11 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href forms: three links to 地位 in kanji/位, two to 営業 and one to 経営 in kanji/営, two to 範囲 in kanji/囲, one to 位 in articles/numbers-and-counters, and one in each of the seven word cards (けち, 貯金 and 贅沢 to 節約; 管理 to 経営; 組 to 組む; 行儀 to 態度; 過ごす to 経つ). In 過ごす the link wraps 経つ inside 時間が経つ, because the Russian sentence has no standalone 経つ. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word or article targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
